notes: Free Power analogue of FW-04-a (Free Power UNKNOWN text FW:1183); severity cost (grid import, battery held at 100 %, 244 untouched). The surviving data, retry and START journal records equal those of a cleanly completed lease except for the marker, so they prove NVS loss, not an outstanding obligation; the S4 record's planned F11.h marker-lost check needs a durable retry operator_needed = 1, which an ACTIVE lease does not hold.
ownership: Free Power holds an ACTIVE 30 min lease (synthetic 3000 W -> 58 A); no other obligation
smallest_safe_repair_scope: on_boot only (description, not implemented): when a lease marker loads LOAD_ABSENT and the same domain's current-tag data record (FP V4 / Dump V2) loads OK with active_persisted == 1, treat the domain as UNKNOWN with the existing READ_ERROR-marker lockout (snapshot_valid = true, metadata_corrupt = true, a 'marker lost' status; no commit, no Modbus at boot). Key it on active_persisted == 1, never on a bare 'data loads' or 'retry record exists': a START whose marker commit failed honestly leaves active_persisted = 0 (and, for Dump, a retry record, committed before the marker). Limits: (a) the loss becomes alarmed, not contained - Dump containment stays unarmed as for a READ_ERROR marker (the N13 shape), so 244 = 0 stays until an operator acts; (b) the data record is never reset at lease end, so it also locks an idle domain whose CLEAR marker was lost (fail-closed, consistent with the S4 vanish rule) and that lockout has no in-firmware exit (availability cost; the exit must stay operator-reviewed, never automatic); (c) it cannot see a whole-partition erase (FW-04-d) or a Phase-B false positive on a used device (stale CLEAR, FW-06-b / FW-06-c). For Free Power it is a fail-closed UNKNOWN lockout only, never an automatic restore from the data record: it makes the stranded override visible and blocks the laundering START (FW-04-c) and the cross-domain Dump START, but does not end the lease.
